long_biography.plain_text:
Early Light began as a Hong Kong toy factory in 1972, but under Francis Choi it became the base for a much broader private group. Choi had started as a toy salesman, distributing piecework through Kowloon housing estates and teaching families how to assemble products. That hands-on model grew into large-scale manufacturing serving global brands, with later factories in Shenzhen and Shaoguan.

Property changed the balance of the fortune. Choi accumulated Hong Kong real estate when prices were depressed. It eventually became the main anchor of his wealth. Early Light now combines manufacturing with property management and development, watch and jewellery retail, automotive services and education. He remains the group's chairman and, separately, a vice chairman and non-executive director of Regal Hotels International.

uncertainties.detail: The immutable record reverses the Chinese-order Choi Chee Ming into Chee Ming Choi and does not include the established alias Francis. HKEX explicitly gives Choi Chee Ming with Francis as an alias; Forbes and PolyU use Francis Choi Chee-ming. The display and sort values are therefore proposed in the widely used public English form, while the compound given name Chee Ming is preserved.

Chee Ming Choi is not resolved from name similarity alone. The exact-name HKEX filing supplies Francis as alias, age 74, Early Light chairmanship and manufacturing/property interests ten days before the immutable age snapshot. Those independent anchors distinguish him from researchers, professionals and other similarly named people.

A 1945 birth year is consistent across the exact-age HKEX evidence, Forbes age and the dedicated biographical record, so it is proposed at high confidence. Public sources vary between Shanghai and Guangdong/Jieyang for the precise birthplace, and no strong day or month was located; place, day and month are left blank.

Forbes lists Hong Kong citizenship and residence, while the immutable record uses Chinese nationality and China residence. The nationality taxonomy may use Chinese broadly, so nationality is retained; the main residence is corrected to Hong Kong because that is directly evidenced. No secondary nationality is proposed.

Toy manufacturing was the first wealth-creation mechanism, but Forbes now identifies property as the anchor or bulk of the fortune. Manufacturing is therefore the origin industry and real estate the current primary industry; exact value allocation and property-ownership entities remain private.

Forbes describes a poor, labor-intensive beginning and the absence of an inherited or family-business platform. This supports Self-made — independent start, though public sources do not provide a complete family financial history.

Current sources verify Early Light chairmanship and Regal Hotels vice-chairmanship. Group business lines and company properties are not automatically treated as assets personally titled to Choi, and no undisclosed ownership percentages are inferred.
The dedicated Forbes and Wikipedia pages and canonical Early Light website are verified. No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram or standalone personal website was found strongly enough to propose.
Politics, controversies, allegations, legal matters, private-family detail, personal collections, current rankings and valuations, transient company metrics and vessel-specific research are excluded.
